# ATS019 — Platform APIs and Self-Service Capabilities (Certified Cloud Native Platform Engineer)

[![Liberapay](https://img.shields.io/badge/Liberapay-Support_Astrona.io-F6C915?logo=liberapay&logoColor=black&style=for-the-badge)](https://liberapay.com/Astrona.io)

Training material for the Platform APIs and Self-Service Capabilities domain of the Certified Cloud Native Platform Engineer (CNPE) exam (25%). The reader builds a platform API from the bottom up: a CustomResourceDefinition that validates its own input, an operator whose reconcile loop acts on it, a Crossplane composite resource that turns one request into many in-cluster objects, and a self-service workflow around it with Argo Workflows, Argo Events, Git requests and RBAC scoped to the platform API. Breadth over depth: each tool is taught for the job the exam asks of it, plus how to read its status when it fails. Everything runs offline in a single-node kind cluster.

This course covers the **Platform APIs and Self-Service Capabilities** domain of the Certified Cloud Native Platform Engineer (CNPE) exam, **25% of the exam**.

Everything lives under `sections/`. Each section is a set of modules, and each module is:

- a **landing page** (`course.md`) plus, where the subject needs it, ordered **deep-dive parts** (`course-0N-*.md`), woven with hands-on "Try it" checkpoints and Mermaid diagrams;
- an ungraded **playground** — a throwaway environment to explore in;

Each section ends with a **capstone lab** combining its modules and a knowledge-check quiz.

[`astrona.yaml`](astrona.yaml) is the manifest: every section, module, reading, playground, lab and capstone in the order they are meant to be taken.

Everything targets **kind 0.33.0**, **kubernetes 1.35.8**, **kind_node_image kindest/node:v1.35.8**, **crossplane 2.4.2**, **provider_kubernetes 1.4.1**, **function_patch_and_transform 0.11.0**, **prometheus_operator 0.94.1**, **prometheus 3.15.0**, **argo_workflows 4.1.5**, **argo_events 1.9.11**, **argo_cd 3.5.4**, **gitea 28.1.0**, **helm 4.3.0**, **podinfo 6.15.0**, **go_httpbin 2.25.0** on `kind`.

## How to work through it

1. Open the section's `README.md` for the map.
2. Read each module's `course.md`, then its deep-dive parts in order.
3. Boot the module playground and run the "Try it" checkpoints alongside the text.
4. Solve the section capstone without looking at the walkthrough.
5. Take the section quiz, then the final domain quiz once every section is done.
